sbar.situation: The bank payment journey has recovered. The last two recovery checks, the latest at 24 seconds, were both clean.
sbar.background: The gateway process stopped answering, so the payment journey timed out at the first step. Earlier, the scheduler changed the payments setting max_transfer_minor from 1000000 to 1; no change was made to the gateway.
sbar.assessment: There were two root causes: the gateway process was down, and payments had a bad max_transfer_minor setting that was hidden because payments got no traffic. The incident commander restarted the gateway itself, which worked, and it restored max_transfer_minor from 1 to 1000000 itself, which also worked.
sbar.recommendation: Find out why the scheduler set max_transfer_minor to 1 and stop it from happening again. Operations should check whether any transfers were rejected or timed out during the outage. The screening-standby stop and start events were planned maintenance and need no action.
